result.brief: 提出 LoCo-WAM：在测试时用新观测帧更新视频专家的低秩适配器，使世界-动作模型以短历史窗口获得长上下文经验，提升未来帧预测与机器人任务成功率。
result.reason: Test-time low-rank adaptation of a video expert in world-action models extends effective context for future-frame prediction; contributes to world-model adaptation rather than a new representation.
